content_sections.heading: About AIAHL
content_sections.text: AI Assets Holding Limited was established under the Companies Act, 2013, with its registered office at 2nd Floor, AI Admin Building, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi-110003. The notice describes it as a 100% Government of India PSU company, incorporated in January 2018 as a Special Purpose Vehicle formed for the disinvestment of Air India Ltd. AIAHL has been mandated to coordinate with CGHS for providing medical facilities and to manage the Medical Cell for post-transaction scrutiny and verification of claims of hospitalization of AI retirees. The advertised post sits in this Medical Cell.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice advertises a single post with 1 vacancy. It does not give a category-wise break-up, but states that reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS applies as per Govt. directives.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 62 years as on the date of notification. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. The date of the notification is not printed in the notice. Applications are invited from Indian Citizens. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS applies as per Govt. directives. A private sector candidate must submit a certificate from the existing employer, on the company's letter head, certifying that the candidate works as Officer or equivalent in the Administration Dept. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.qualification: MBBS from any institution recognized by MCI (Medical Council Of India)
rows.experience: Central/State/Public Sector Enterprises: working at the level of E-1 or equivalent level and above for the past 10 years. Private Sector: minimum 10 years of experience, of which 03 years in Scrutiny and Settlement of Medical Claims & Medical Insurance Related Work.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The tenure can be extended or curtailed as per the requirement of the company. The contract could be terminated at the discretion of the management during the period of contract, and/or in the event of unsatisfactory performance. No claim for regular employment by virtue of this contractual engagement will be entertained at any stage. The selected candidate must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination. The candidate bears the cost of this examination and of any additional tests, if required.

rows.component: Total monthly salary and allowances (Cost to Company basis)

rows.amount_term: Rs.38,500/- (out of pocket taxable allowances: fuel, transport and telephone)
3% p.a. on the salary amount of Rs.1,10,000/-, subject to satisfactory annual performance appraisal reports
Fixed Term Employment Contract for a period of one year

content_sections.heading: AIAHL Medical Officer in Medical Cell Job Description
content_sections.text: Verification of claims with respect to various test procedures conducted by empaneled hospital under NHA. Resolving claim related queries and discrepancies, follow up and respond to queries of retired employees in person/email. Liaison with UTIITSL, CGHS and Panel Hospitals. Preparing the weekly consolidated reports and updating to the Management. Liaison with the hospitals as and when required: (a) admission related queries, (b) prolonged admission. Any other medical related issue pertaining to AI retired employees.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIAHL Medical Officer in Medical Cell
content_sections.text: The notice asks candidates to apply on paper. It prints no application start date. The last date of receipt is 1700 hours on 10 December 2026. Applications that are incomplete or received after the last date will not be entertained. Any extension will be notified on the AIAHL websites named in the notice. Selection involves a personal interview of candidates who prima facie meet the eligibility criteria. Meeting the criteria does not give a right to be shortlisted or called for interview or to be considered further. If candidates are not found suitable, AIAHL may conduct an interview after every two weeks. The interview date will be notified only on www.aiahl.in , www.aiesl.in , www.allianceair.in , www.aiasl.in and the Centaur Hotels website named in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A recent passport size photograph pasted in the space provided in the Application Format. One set of photocopies of supporting testimonials for date of birth, caste, qualification, experience etc. For private sector candidates: a certificate from the existing employer, on the company's letter head, certifying that the candidate works as Officer or equivalent in the Administration Dept. A duly filled in application form in the prescribed format. A write-up of not more than 400 words in support of the candidature. Original certificates are required at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Medical Officer vacancies has AIAHL announced?
faq.answer: AIAHL has announced 1 vacancy for Medical Officer in Medical Cell, with Delhi as the place of posting.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIAHL Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 1700 hours on 10 December 2026. Incomplete applications or those received after the last date will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the AIAHL Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The qualification is MBBS from any institution recognized by MCI (Medical Council Of India), along with the experience the notice specifies for government or private sector candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required?
faq.answer: Central/State/Public Sector Enterprise candidates need to have worked at level E-1 or equivalent and above for the past 10 years. Private sector candidates need a minimum of 10 years, including 03 years in scrutiny and settlement of medical claims and medical insurance related work.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 62 years as on the date of notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the AIAHL Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The total monthly salary and allowances are Rs.1,48,500 on a Cost to Company basis: salary Rs.1,10,000 plus allowances Rs.38,500, with an annual increment of 3% on the salary subject to satisfactory appraisal reports.

faq.question: Q7. Are allowances paid on top of the salary?
faq.answer: The notice includes the allowances of Rs.38,500 (out of pocket taxable allowances for fuel, transport and telephone) within the total of Rs.1,48,500. It names no other allowance.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the AIAHL Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Download and fill in the Application Format from www.aiahl.in or the other websites the notice names, then send it with documents by Post, Speed Post or Courier to Manager (HR & Admin), AIAHL, 2nd Floor, AI Admin Building, Safdarjung Airport, New Delhi-110003.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection involves a personal interview of candidates who prima facie meet the eligibility criteria. The selected candidate must then undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination at their own cost.

faq.question: Q10. Is the AIAHL Medical Officer post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is on a Fixed Term Employment Contract for one year, which can be extended or curtailed as per the company's requirement, and the notice states that no claim for regular employment will be entertained.
